description.zh: 发起会话后，指定执行的命令内容。长度不能超过 512 个字符。
description.en: The command to run after the session is started. The command can be up to 512 characters in length.

description.zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the Simple Application Server instance.

description.zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the Simple Application Server instance. You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions.
